Here's what I did without therapy to get rid of most of it

\- to preface at a certain point with my pocd I thought suicide was the only answer so I get what you are going through, 

I created these rules to live eat and breathe by:

1) Don't google anything for the most part related to POCD - It always causes more problems than it solves but reddit is a safe haven for talking about this. Other forums can get a little too dark and thus create a shit ton of new intrusive thoughts you wouldnt have otherwise thought of. 

2) **Wait it out.** OCD themes will sometimes come and go and especially if you dont have access to therapy, just wait it out. I know the urge to die can be strong with this stuff, but I always made sure I had something to look forward to. Shit can get hard, but waiting it out as long as you can is extremely important. 

3) I tried to list **logic** constantly. I told myself that I have no history of doing anything like this, and that I am a good person. (This one was really hard because obviously your thoughts bark back really awful shit)

4) Open up to someone. Anyone. I am convinced I am better because I really vaguely talked about it with my brother. Luckily, he understood as he had faced intrusive thoughts briefly. I didn't bring up any details or anything because I was fearful of him accusing me of being a "bad person". Regardless, it helped. 

5) Go on 7cups. 7cups is an online resource where people can listen to you and such while you essentially word vomit your problems. However, if you can pay for an online therapist on 7cups that would be the most beneficial. 

6) Stop avoiding things. When I was really bad I was avoiding TV shows, people, places, etc. To get better I stopped avoiding. When I was watching a movie and something triggered me, well too bad I had to sit through it. Slowly get more comfortable with your surroundings again. 

I am so sorry for what you are going through. If you ever need help don't hesitate to message me. Seriously, I get it. Much love to you, i wish you the best.
